findings.description: Ukrainian honorific capitalization of Вам applies when addressing one specific person. Here the explanation explicitly refers to several people, and the quoted word is not sentence-initial.

items.reviewerAnswer: Nos gusta; os gusta; les gusta.
sources: Ukrainian Orthography (2019), rules on honorific capitalization of Ви and Ваш when addressing one specific person (from memory).

findings.description: The blanket distinction between gustar and all other verbs is false. Encantar, already included in this lesson, also takes A mí tampoco in the equivalent exchange.
findings.suggestion: Restrict Yo tampoco to constructions where the corresponding person is the subject, and explicitly include encantar with the gustar pattern.

items.reviewerAnswer: tampoco expresses negative addition. Replies include A mí tampoco with gustar or encantar, and Yo tampoco with appropriate subject-based constructions.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, chapter 35, indirect objects and dative experiencers (from memory).
RAE/ASALE, Diccionario de la lengua española, encantar, the sense expressing strong liking (from memory).

findings.location: content.body.steps[id=s3].taskIds: "A1-06-L1-T16", before the infinitive explanation in steps[id=s4].blocks: "Що подобається робити — gusta + інфінітив."
findings.description: Required task T16 asks learners to translate a complete preference sentence with viajar before step s4 introduces gustar + infinitive. Step s1 teaches pronouns using noun complements and does not teach this construction.
findings.suggestion: Move T16 after the infinitive explanation, or teach gustar + infinitive before s3.

items.reviewerAnswer: Teach the pronoun system, then noun agreement and infinitive constructions, before requiring full-sentence production with those constructions.
items.notes: The summary also mentions four steps, while the teaching sections are numbered only 1–3; clarify whether listening is intended as the fourth.
sources: This case, content.body.steps s1, s3, and s4; packet task:A1-06-L1-T16, task.prompt.

findings.description: Full-sentence production requires the generic common-noun pattern with an article. The prerequisite map gives only bare me/te/le gusta forms and vocabulary; it does not establish the gustar.noun-with-article construction introduced in this lesson.
findings.suggestion: Map gustar.noun-with-article as previously taught, or supply the noun phrase and assess only the pronoun.

items.notes: The Spanish key is correct. The defect concerns the prerequisite map.
sources: This case, context.taughtBefore; packet skill:gustar.noun-with-article, content.body.firstLesson and ruleUk.

findings.description: The task requires producing the article-bearing common-noun construction, but taughtBefore establishes only the pronoun forms. The lesson's separate gustar.noun-with-article prerequisite is missing.
findings.suggestion: Establish and map gustar.noun-with-article before this task, or provide the sentence frame.

items.notes: The accepted Spanish answers are correct.
sources: This case, context.taughtBefore; packet skill:gustar.noun-with-article, content.body.firstLesson and ruleUk.

findings.description: The task transfers the reply construction to encantar without mapping its gustar-like syntax as taught. TaughtBefore includes encantar only as a vocabulary gloss; its response examples all use gustar.
findings.suggestion: Add prior teaching of gustar.encantar, including its dative construction, to taughtBefore.

items.notes: The answer key is correct. The error feedback would also be clearer if it referred to encantar or the gustar family.
sources: This case, context.taughtBefore: "encantar — дуже подобатися" and the gustar.responses examples.

findings.location: clips[0].transcript: "no me gusta nada el teatro"; context.taughtBefore
findings.description: The assessed recording introduces nada in the negative-degree construction without prior teaching or an accessible gloss. TaughtBefore models no me gusta without nada; the packet identifies this construction as new in gustar.degree.
findings.suggestion: Add prior teaching of gustar.degree, specifically no me gusta nada, to the prerequisite map, or remove nada from this recording.

items.notes: The key and Ukrainian translation agree with the transcript. Audio was not assessed.

findings.location: clips[0].transcript: "A mi hermano le encanta nadar, y a mí también."; context.taughtBefore
findings.description: The listening item depends on the named dative experiencer construction and gustar-like encantar syntax. Neither construction is established in taughtBefore; encantar appears only as a vocabulary gloss.
findings.suggestion: Map prior teaching of gustar.a-noun-le and gustar.encantar, including their use together, before assessing this recording.

items.notes: The meaning key and translation are correct. Audio was not assessed.

findings.location: clips[0].transcript and task.accepted[0].text: "Me gusta mucho el cine y no me gusta nada el teatro."; context.taughtBefore
findings.description: The dictation includes the newly introduced nada construction without establishing it in taughtBefore or providing a vocabulary gloss. Optional status does not remove the prerequisite requirement.
findings.suggestion: Map prior teaching of no me gusta nada under gustar.degree, or use a recording containing only established forms.

items.reviewerAnswer: Me gusta mucho el cine y no me gusta nada el teatro.
items.notes: The written key matches the supplied transcript. Audio was not assessed.

findings.description: The task requires producing gustar + infinitive, but taughtBefore establishes only the pronoun forms and the word viajar. It does not establish this new construction. The lesson also schedules T16 before its infinitive explanation.
findings.suggestion: Teach and map gustar.infinitive first, and move T16 after that explanation.

sources: Packet lesson:A1-06-L1, content.body.steps s3 and s4.

findings.description: Producing the complete sentence requires gustar + infinitive. TaughtBefore supplies the pronouns and the lexical infinitive bailar but does not establish their construction.
findings.suggestion: Add prior teaching of gustar.infinitive to the prerequisite map, or provide the infinitive frame and assess only Les.

findings.location: task.prompt[0].text: "Переклади іспанською: «Їм подобається бігати в парку»."; context.taughtBefore
findings.description: The required plural experiencer pronoun les is not established in taughtBefore. The listed pronoun target covers me, te, and le; the infinitive examples add nos but not les.
findings.suggestion: Add gustar.pronouns.plural as a taught prerequisite before requiring this translation.

items.reviewerAnswer: Les gusta correr en el parque.
items.notes: The accepted Spanish sentence is correct.
sources: This case, context.taughtBefore: gustar.pronouns and gustar.infinitive examples.

findings.location: task.prompt[0].text: "Перепиши речення повністю, вставивши артиклі: «Мені подобається чай і подобаються яблука»."; task.slots[id=s2].errors: "unas"
findings.description: The prompt does not specify generic liking or require definite articles. Unas manzanas can refer to some particular apples, a reading the Ukrainian sentence does not exclude. The error feedback assumes a generic interpretation that the prompt leaves unstated.
findings.suggestion: Specify that the preferences concern tea and apples in general and explicitly request definite articles, or provide a context that determines the intended articles.

items.reviewerAnswer: Me gusta el té y me gustan las manzanas. An indefinite reading of the apples is also possible without further context.
items.notes: The reference answer is correct under the intended generic reading.
sources: Course contract, rules 3 and 4, and the definition of uncertain.
RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, chapter 15, indefinite articles, genericity, and specificity (from memory).

findings.location: task.prompt[0].text: "Обери правильне речення."; task.options[id=c]: "Me gustan unos perros." marked incorrect
findings.description: The prompt asks for a correct sentence without specifying general preferences. Option c is grammatical with a particular, indefinite group of dogs. Only its feedback introduces the generic interpretation needed to exclude it.
findings.suggestion: Ask which sentence expresses liking dogs in general, or accept both grammatical options for the current wording.

items.reviewerAnswer: a and c are grammatical: a can express a general liking for dogs; c expresses liking for some particular dogs.
sources: Course contract, rule 2 and the definition of uncertain.
RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, chapter 15, indefinite articles and specificity (from memory).

findings.location: task.prompt[0].text: "Переклади іспанською: «Моїм друзям не подобається футбол»."; context.taughtBefore
findings.description: Full-sentence production requires a + named experiencer with the accompanying clitic. TaughtBefore establishes negation and pronouns but does not establish gustar.a-noun-le.
findings.suggestion: Map prior teaching of gustar.a-noun-le, including the plural named experiencer pattern, before this task.

items.reviewerAnswer: A mis amigos no les gusta el fútbol.

findings.location: task.prompt[0].text: "Друг пропонує приготувати вечерю разом. Скажи іспанською: «Мені не подобається готувати»."; context.taughtBefore
findings.description: The task requires producing gustar + infinitive. Its prerequisite map contains noun-based negation examples and the vocabulary cocinar, but no teaching of the infinitive construction.
findings.suggestion: Add prior teaching of gustar.infinitive to taughtBefore, or supply the infinitive frame.

findings.location: task.prompt[0].text: "Розкажи іспанською про брата з encantar: «Мій брат обожнює футбол»."; context.taughtBefore
findings.description: The task requires producing a + named experiencer with le. The mapped encantar examples contain only clitic experiencers, and gustar.a-noun-le is absent from taughtBefore.
findings.suggestion: Establish and map the named experiencer construction and its extension to encantar before this task.

items.reviewerAnswer: A mi hermano le encanta el fútbol.
items.notes: The accepted Spanish sentence is correct.

findings.location: task.prompt[0].text: "Розкажи іспанською про маму (з mucho): «Моїй мамі дуже подобається танцювати»."; context.taughtBefore
findings.description: Producing the sentence requires a + named experiencer and its clitic. The prerequisite map covers degree, negation, agreement, infinitives, and clitic pronouns, but omits gustar.a-noun-le.
findings.suggestion: Add prior teaching of gustar.a-noun-le to taughtBefore.

items.reviewerAnswer: A mi madre le gusta mucho bailar. Also: A mi mamá le gusta mucho bailar.
items.notes: The reference answer is correct. The key is not declared closed, so the unlisted mamá variant is not demonstrably rejected.
